ab_mount_snowdome_slipstream.name_checked: Slipstream, Snow Dome (Mount Snowdome), Columbia Icefield

climb_hrs.note: one party Apr 28 2026: left camp below route 0600, top ~1330 (camp to top, includes approach to the route from camp); not a base-to-top figure
climb_hrs.quote: started from our camp below the route at 0600

total_hrs.note: camp to camp, one party Apr 2026, rapped the icefall; party time (report itself does not say 'Slipstream is on Snow Dome')

ab_mount_snowdome_slipstream.other: MP: Ice, Alpine, 3000 ft (909 m), Grade VI, WI4+; 50 m ice curtain then '3 more pitches of ice climbing'; descent 'a few more ice raps down the gully'. No hours on MP page.
ab_mount_snowdome_slipstream.stuck: No guidebook-style climb hours found; only one dated party time (camp to camp). Cascadeclimbers/Roskelley TR 403 or not opened.

pitches.note: roped pitches up buttress to East Ridge, plus scrambling above and below; page then guesses '6? more roped pitches' on the ridge
AAJ first-ascent-style account: three and a half pitches mostly 5.7-5.8 then 5th and short 6th pitch (shorter line, joins E ridge)
pitches.quote: three and a half pitches, mostly 5.7 or 5.8

ab_mount_temple_squashed_bones.other: MP: 3600 ft (1091 m), Grade IV, 5.8; 'Expect a full day out'; from top of Black Towers 'about another hour walk to the summit'; no hours for approach/descent. AAJ rates IV 5.8.
ab_mount_temple_squashed_bones.stuck: No climb/total hours stated on any page found. (Greenwood-Jones, a different route, is 17.5 hr car to car per Abegg - not evidence.)

ak_mount_yukla_2_gank_d_and_slayed.name_checked: Gank'd and Slayed, Pt. 6,000' of Mt. Yukla, Chugach
ak_mount_yukla_2_gank_d_and_slayed.other: AAJ: '2,800', V WI6 M6 A2'; descended Icicle Glacier via standard NE Ridge; party left base camp at treeline early morning. No totals given. Cascadeclimbers TR 403.
ak_mount_yukla_2_gank_d_and_slayed.stuck: AAJ page has no hours or pitch total; cascadeclimbers returned 403 (skipped).

climb_hrs.note: camp to summit, one party Aug 2006 (includes approach to col, which took ~1 hr after a col mix-up)
climb_hrs.quote: summit at 11:30am, 4 hours after leaving camp

approach_hrs.note: camp to the col, roughly, per party (wrong col first)
approach_hrs.quote: At 7:25, we headed for the col

descent_hrs.note: summit to camp, descending the route (raps, 25 m)
descent_hrs.quote: 3.5 hours to descend the route and arrive back at camp

total_hrs.note: camp to camp = 4 up + 3.5 down (sum of the two stated figures)
total_hrs.quote: 4 hours after leaving camp; 3.5 hours to descend

bc_bugaboo_spire_kain_route_south_ridge.other: Abegg: 440 m col to summit, several low class 5 pitches, six rappel stations of 25 m on upper route. MP: descend via rappels and scrambling. FKT page: 3h52m48s trailhead round trip (Burke 2022), a record not a typical time.

climb_hrs.note: col to summit, one party (1 h 55 min)
climb_hrs.quote: 1 h 55 min to get from the col to the summit

approach_hrs.quote: 2 hours to get to the Uto-Sir Donald Col

descent_hrs.note: summit to trailhead, NW ridge/west face raps and walk out
descent_hrs.quote: 4.5 hours to descend from the summit back to the trailhead

total_hrs.quote: round trip car to car ... took 8 hours

total_hrs.note: round trip from lower bivy site, guidebook-style range

bc_mount_sir_donald_northwest_ridge.other: Parks Canada: descent via 15 two-bolt stations at 25 m (one 50 m rope), or 4th-class downclimb to trail; 1998 m gain trailhead to summit, 713 m col to summit. No pitch count on either page.

bc_mount_waddington_kiwi_route.name_checked: Kiwi Route, Mount Waddington (from Combatant Col)

total_hrs.note: MP says up and down in a day is possible from a camp on the Col; no hours
total_hrs.quote: possible to go up and down in a day

pitches.note: from the notch to the summit only

bc_mount_waddington_kiwi_route.other: MP: 3100 ft (939 m), 5.7/AI3/M3+, descent = 4 raps with double 70 m ropes then Angel Glacier. 2014 blog party: left col ~2am, began rappelling ~4pm after summit, back to camp late evening (no summit time; multi-day-ish narrative, not a clean time).
bc_mount_waddington_kiwi_route.stuck: No clean stated climb hours. Blog gives clock times 2am to ~4pm start of raps (about 14 hr col to start of descent) but summit time unstated, so not recorded as a figure.

bc_yak_peak_madness.name_checked: Madness (5.9 R, Gr III), Yak Peak, Coquihalla (confirmed on MP)

approach_hrs.note: from Zopkios rest area, general Yak Peak approach (cited on a neighbouring route's page, not Madness)

pitches.note: only '6 long pitches' up the dihedral named, then 'several' loose pitches, plus ~300 m low-angle slab soloed; no total

bc_yak_peak_madness.other: MP: 1400 ft (424 m), 5.9 R, FA Serl/Creighton 1987; crux loose rock. Approach figure is from search snippet of the CardiYak page, not opened - treat as unconfirmed. Neighbouring Yak-Check (not Madness): 7.5 hr car to car per Abegg - not evidence for Madness.

ca_north_face_17_cowardice.name_checked: Cowardice, North Face, Mount Morrison (Eastern Sierra, Convict Lake/McGee Creek); Trad, Mixed, Snow, Alpine, 1400 ft (424 m), Grade III

pitches.note: two 70 m pitches then a traverse and a long snow couloir (no rock steps) to the NW Ridge
pitches.quote: two pitches, each 70m, then a traverse

ca_north_face_17_cowardice.other: Descent: climb to summit and go down the East Face, or descend NW Ridge via loose 3rd class to a couloir to skier's right. Starts on NW shoulder; shares start with Learning to Walk; easier than Deception.
ca_north_face_17_cowardice.stuck: No hours on the MP page or elsewhere found.
